objectives.name: the toll roof
objectives.text: Run the office roofs to the toll tower

objectives.name: the bridge
objectives.text: Cross the district to the Silt bridge

radio.line: Glass coming up. Don't slow down, jump right through it.
Now, the Glass District's got a toll, folks. And Parker doesn't strike me as a guy who pays tolls.
Spotters on the toll roof. They're calling you in to him. Shut 'em up, or just get past.
...and the weather out west is, uh, glass. Mostly glass. Bring a broom. Back to you.
That bridge is the only way over the Silt. Get across before he gets ideas.
Parker, hang on. Something's off with that bridge.

do.cue: He's at the bridge, folks. Shame about the bridge.

radio.line: Glass District. Office roofs to the toll tower, then the bridge.
Morning, Glass District! Heads up, our courier's coming through, and he is not slowing down.
Higher roof. Run at the ledge and jump, you'll get up.
My spotters! Do you know how hard it is to find people who can count to three?
Wall hop. First wall, then jump to the second.
He's at the bridge, folks. Shame about the bridge.

bail.line: Ooh, careful, that's a real... well, it was a window.
Down he goes! Folks, we're gonna need more glass.
Through the window and right into my heart, folks.
Glass everywhere. Somebody sweep that up.

combo.line: Listen to that glass go! That's music, that is.
He's good. I hate that he's good.
The man's a walking highlight reel. A bleeding one, but still.

fall.line: And he's back on the street, where he belongs!
Find a way up. You know how.
Street level! Mind the Silt, darling.

kill.line: Oh, come on. Do you know how hard it is to find people who can climb?
Another one! Folks, I'm running out of lookouts.
And the lookout's... not looking out. Not anymore.
That spotter had a family, you know. Well. A rat. He called it Biscuit.

headshot.line: Ooh. Right in the earpiece. Feedback, everybody.
Yeesh. Somebody clean that up, the windows are bad enough.
Yes. That's how you do it.

down.line: Courier down! On the glass, too. That's gotta sting.
Get up. Keep the glass between you and them.
Aaand he's down. Don't touch that dial, folks.
Don't stand there trading shots. Run, then shoot.

tape.line: ...he's got lookouts on every roof with glass. They watch the reflections. Stay low, stay quick.
...if anyone finds this, go west. Keep going west. He keeps the keys on his belt.
